staff.name: Yodry Gonzalez
staff.description: Senior Nail Technician With over 10 years of experience, Yodry is a true master of nail artistry. Known for precision, creativity, and flawless technique, Yodry specializes in creating stunning nail designs that combine beauty and durability. Whether it’s classic elegance or bold, trend-forward looks, Yodry delivers exceptional results every time. At The Powder Room, your nails are in expert hands.

staff.name: Alfredo Barrera
staff.description: Master Stylist With over 15 years of experience in hair, color, makeup, and styling, Alfredo Barrera brings a wealth of artistry and passion to The Powder Room. Originally from Colombia, Alfredo has worked on prestigious pageants, including Miss Universe, crafting flawless looks for contestants on the global stage. Known for his impeccable technique and eye for beauty, Alfredo transforms every client into the best version of themselves, whether it’s a glamorous makeover or everyday elegance.
